Troopod · TrooCRO Creative Programme
02
WHY PDP CREATIVES MATTER

The gap between browsing and buying

Furniture is felt before it is bought. On a screen, a customer cannot run a hand over the grain or stand next to the piece to judge its size. Every unanswered question at this stage becomes a reason to leave without buying — and a well-built PDP creative is what answers it.

"Will it actually fit my space?"

Dimensions alone are hard to picture. Without a sense of scale, customers underestimate or overestimate size and hesitate to commit.

"Is the quality worth this price?"

Handcrafted wood and resin work carries real craftsmanship, but a flat product photo rarely shows the grain, finish or weight that justifies it.

"How will I actually use it?"

Multi-piece and multi-functional products need to be seen in use, not just displayed, before a customer can imagine it in their own home.

This is why the programme exists: 15 or more products every month, each given the 5 to 7 creatives it actually needs, so every product page removes doubt instead of leaving it unanswered.
03
FLEXIBLE 5-TO-7 CREATIVE MODEL

The number of creatives follows the product, not a fixed rule

A single side table and a multi-piece nesting set don't need the same number of stories. We size the creative set to what the product actually needs to explain.

5 creatives

Simpler products

Limited features and a straightforward use case — five focused creatives are enough to remove doubt.

6 creatives

Standard products

Balanced storytelling across scale, material and everyday use for the bulk of the catalogue.

7 creatives

Complex, high-value products

Multi-piece sets and high-priority launches that need fuller explanation before a customer commits.

We do not force seven creatives when five communicate the product effectively, and we do not reduce the count if an important product question would be left unanswered.
04
CREATIVE FRAMEWORK · 1 OF 3

Size and scale storytelling

Before anything else, a customer needs to trust that the product will fit their space. These two creative types remove that doubt in a single glance.

Creative type 01

Scale and dimensions

A human silhouette placed beside the product with full dimensions, so size is felt, not just read as a number.

Creative type 02

Quick size comparison

A clean elevation showing every size or component with its measurement, so differences are easy to scan at a glance.

05
CREATIVE FRAMEWORK · 2 OF 3

Functionality and everyday usage

Once size is settled, the customer needs to picture the product actually living in their home — being used, not just displayed.

Creative type 04

Functionality and flexibility

Both tables in a nesting set shown in use at once — one holding chai, the other a book — so the customer sees how the set solves a real space and usage problem.

Creative type 03

Everyday Indian moment

A lit diya on the tabletop grounds the product in a familiar Indian home moment, not a staged studio scene.

Creative type 05

Everyday convenience

The product beside a sofa holding a glass of water and a book — the simple, practical role it plays every day.

06
CREATIVE FRAMEWORK · 3 OF 3

Material quality and lifestyle storytelling

The last doubt is about quality itself, and the last nudge is emotional. Together, these two creative types close the decision.

Creative type 06

Material and finish

An extreme close-up of the wood grain, resin pour and edge finish — the detail that justifies a premium, handcrafted price.

Creative type 07

Aspirational lifestyle

The product in a warm, lived-in setting, so the customer can emotionally place it inside their own home before they buy.

07
CREATIVE PRODUCTION & QUALITY CONTROL

Every creative is built on the real product

The framework only adapts the story, never the product. Every creative starts from verified product images and specifications, and preserves:

✓Exact product shape and proportions
✓Number of product components
✓Verified product dimensions
✓Tabletop or body thickness
✓Number, position and construction of legs
✓True wood colour and grain
✓True resin colour and pattern
✓Materials and finish
✓Doors, drawers, shelves and hardware
✓Functional configuration
✓Joinery and construction detail
What we will not do: redesign or structurally alter the product, or invent dimensions, materials, durability claims, capacity or functional features that are not real.
